previous_statement: Compression-map identity: by def-compressed-corner, Co_{P,Q}=theta(B_{P,Q}) and Co_{P_n,Q_n}=theta(B_{P_n,Q_n}). The raw-operator identity and theta naturality therefore give Co_{P_n,Q_n}=theta(iota_n(B_{P,Q}))=iota_n(theta(B_{P,Q}))=1_{M_n} tensor Co_{P,Q}.
new_statement: The proposed compression-map identity is not derivable from the allowed inputs. By def-compressed-corner and node 1.2 one obtains Co_{P_n,Q_n}=theta(iota_n(B_{P,Q})), whereas 1_{M_n} tensor Co_{P,Q}=iota_n(theta(B_{P,Q})). Equality of these two expressions requires theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). Node 1.3 establishes that equality only under the additional premise that theta is one fixed holomorphic functional-calculus function on a common spectral neighbourhood; def-compressed-corner does not supply that premise or amplification naturality. Hence the unconditional compression-map identity, and therefore the root contract from the registered inputs alone, remains unproved.
